title: Credential
description: A credential is a certificate that is used to verify the identity of a person or entity.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

credentialCategory.title: Credential Category
credentialCategory.description: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

credentialCategory_text.title: Credential Category (text)
credentialCategory_text.description: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

recognizedBy.title: Recognized By
recognizedBy.description: An organization that acknowledges the validity, value or utility of a credential. Note: recognition may include a process of quality assurance or accreditation.

validFor.title: Valid For
validFor.description: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.

validIn.title: Valid In
validIn.description: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].
